item.title: Self-Hosted Release Notes & Changelog Tools: git-cliff vs Release-Drafter vs release-it (2026)
item.description: Automating release notes and changelog generation is essential for maintaining clean, professional project histories. Instead of manually writing release summaries, self-hosted changelog tools parse git commits, pull requests, and tags to produce structured, readable release notes — all without relying on SaaS platforms.
